mapper.select: select count(*) from emp where emp_email = #{empEmail}
mapper.update: update emp set emp_password = #{empPassword}, emp_birth = #{empBirth}, emp_contact = #{empContact}, emp_post = #{empPost}, emp_address1 = #{empAddress1}, emp_address2 = #{empAddress2}, emp_utime = systimestamp where emp_no = #{empNo}
mapper.select: SELECT e.emp_no, e.emp_name, d.dept_name, p.position_name, e.emp_state, e.emp_email FROM emp e JOIN dept d ON e.emp_dept_no = d.dept_no JOIN position p ON e.emp_position_no = p.position_no ORDER BY e.emp_no

select E.emp_no, E.emp_Name, E.emp_state, E.emp_email, D.dept_Name, P.position_name from emp E join dept D on E.emp_dept_no = D.dept_no join position P on E.emp_position_no = P.position_no
D.dept_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
or P.position_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
or E.emp_state = #{keyword}
or e.emp_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
order by E.emp_no

select E.emp_no, E.emp_name, E.emp_state, E.emp_email, D.dept_name, P.position_name from emp_initial_view E join dept D on E.emp_dept_no = D.dept_no join position P on E.emp_position_no = P.position_no where case when E.initial_no in(0,1) then 'ㄱ' when E.initial_no = 2 then 'ㄴ' when E.initial_no in(3,4) then 'ㄷ' when E.initial_no = 5 then 'ㄹ' when E.initial_no = 6 then 'ㅁ' when E.initial_no in(7,8) then 'ㅂ' when E.initial_no in(9,10) then 'ㅅ' when E.initial_no = 11 then 'ㅇ' when E.initial_no in (12,13) then 'ㅈ' when E.initial_no = 14 then 'ㅊ' when E.initial_no = 15 then 'ㅋ' when E.initial_no = 16 then 'ㅌ' when E.initial_no = 17 then 'ㅍ' when E.initial_no = 18 then 'ㅎ' end = #{tab} order by E.emp_name asc
